title: G63 6x6 vs VelociRaptor 6x6: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two six-wheeled pickups, one from Germany and Austria, one from Texas. The Mercedes G 63 AMG 6x6 had about five hundred thirty-six horsepower and was priced at three hundred seventy-nine thousand euros. The Hennessey VelociRaptor 6x6 claims about six hundred horsepower and started at three hundred forty-nine thousand dollars. Which is the real difference between them? We compare only what our sources actually say. Our sources are Wikipedia, Gear Patrol, The Drive, Motor Authority, Digital Trends, DuPont Registry, Ford Authority, CarAdvice, Carscoops and MercedesBlog. For the Hennessey, several figures differ by outlet, and some basic ones, such as weight, are missing entirely. We show the gaps. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
